content: RFD900x runs SiK firmware (open source, originally 3DR/ArduPilot lineage). Transparent serial pipe; configured via AT commands (S2=AIR_SPEED, S3=NETID, S5=ECC1 Golay FEC toggle). ECC=1 enables 12/24 Golay FEC (corrects up to 3 bad bits per 12) but halves usable throughput; CRC-16 already used for bad-packet detection regardless of ECC setting. MAVLINK framing option aligns radio packets to MAVLink boundaries -- irrelevant for non-MAVLink payloads. Recommend ECC=0 given this project already treats the live link as lossy/unacknowledged.
